scenario: cancel() while a real turn was running
how: live run against opencode/deepseek-v4-flash-free, cancelled 3.5s in
note: `proven` rather than `assumed`: the adapter owns the process, so killing it IS the cancellation rather than an inference about one. The pty adapters cannot say this -- on Claude Code a cancelled turn produces no signal anywhere, and the claim rests on our own bookkeeping.
